svg.title: Use case diagram - Restaurant Rush (final design, tag stage-3)

g.text: Use case diagram - Restaurant Rush (final design, tag stage-3)
One actor: a marker replaying a script plays the same Manager role;
only the source of the commands changes (Replay extends Play a game).
Arrivals, eating, the Cashier's payment and abandonment are steps the
system runs inside every turn, so they are included, not actors.
